references.text: The Lord promised Joshua that no one would be able to stand against him all the days of his life, just as He had promised Moses.
The Lord told Joshua not to fear his enemies, for none of them would be able to stand against him.
The Lord promised to send His terror ahead of Israel and throw all the peoples they met into confusion, so that their enemies would flee.
The Lord said He would put dread and fear of Israel upon all the peoples under the whole heaven, so that they would tremble when they heard about them.
The Lord promised to deliver the kings into Israel's hands, and no one would be able to stand against them.
God's terror fell upon the cities around Jacob, so they did not pursue Jacob's sons.
Rahab reported that the inhabitants of the land were seized with fear for Israel, and their hearts had melted because of the Lord.
Joshua reminded the people that the Lord had driven out great and mighty nations before them, and no one had been able to stand against them.
